intro: This coastal zone runs from the temple streets of Mylapore to the beach at Besant Nagar. Mylapore's older houses stand on narrow lanes near the tank, with apartment buildings on the tree-lined avenues beyond. Alwarpet, between Teynampet and Abhiramapuram, is residential streets of flats in small and mid-sized buildings, with offices and cultural venues on the main roads. Adyar is a cluster of named nagars where independent houses on leafy streets sit beside low-rise apartment blocks. Besant Nagar, a planned layout on numbered streets, mixes houses on the original plots with newer flats and some government quarters, and Thiruvanmiyur adds houses and apartment blocks around its old temple core.

The MRTS is the tutor's line here, running down the eastern side through Light House, Thirumayilai and Mandaveli to Kotturpuram, Adyar's two stations and Thiruvanmiyur, with Teynampet on the Metro Blue Line serving Alwarpet. Besant Nagar has no station, but its bus terminus runs many city routes, and a tutor coming by train finishes by auto. The Purple and Yellow metro lines through the zone are under construction. Traffic builds at the Adyar signal and where the ECR and OMR begin, and temple festival days crowd Mylapore, so an early or late weekday slot usually serves better than one in the evening peak.

faqs: Which MRTS stations serve Adyar and Thiruvanmiyur?

Adyar has two MRTS stops on its eastern side and Thiruvanmiyur has its own, all on the section from Thirumayilai opened on 26 January 2004. The line runs north to Mylapore and Chennai Beach and south towards Velachery. A tutor coming by train usually takes an auto for the last part of the journey.
How do tutors reach Besant Nagar without a station?

By auto from the MRTS stations in Adyar or Thiruvanmiyur, or by bus to the large Besant Nagar terminus. The numbered streets of this planned layout make houses easy to find, and parking a two-wheeler outside is usually simple. Beach crowds build on weekend evenings, which makes a weekday lesson or a morning session the calmer choice.
What do home tutors charge in Mylapore and Alwarpet?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor fixes their own fee and shows it on the profile, so you know it before the free demo.
Is Alwarpet close to a working metro line?

Yes. Teynampet station on the Blue Line, open since 25 May 2018, is the closest working stop, and the MRTS stations in Mylapore are also near. An underground Alwarpet station on the Yellow Line is under construction. Most homes are flats in small buildings, so the tutor gives a name to the watchman and parks on the street.

intro: The centre-west of the city is dense, busy and full of long-settled homes. T Nagar's bazaar streets have crowded out many houses, but its residential pockets still hold older family houses alongside newer blocks of flats. Nungambakkam has apartments, builder-floor buildings and some independent houses on the streets behind its High Road offices and restaurants. In Kodambakkam, flats are steadily replacing older bungalows next to the film studios. West Mambalam packs independent houses, small apartment buildings and old temples into narrow streets, and Saidapet, on the Adyar River, ranges from older working-class streets to houses, flats and a few gated complexes.

This is suburban-train territory. The South Line stops at Nungambakkam, Kodambakkam, Mambalam and Saidapet, so a tutor from as far down the line as Tambaram can ride in, and West Mambalam connects to T Nagar through a subway beneath the railway. The Metro Blue Line adds Saidapet and Little Mount on the southern side, and Ashok Nagar and Vadapalani on the Green Line lie just west. Car parking is hard on the narrow streets, so tutors on two-wheelers, on foot from the station or by auto do better. Shopping weekends, festival seasons and the evening rush on the High Road slow every route, so mid-afternoon or late-evening lessons tend to hold.

For T Nagar, Nungambakkam, Kodambakkam, West Mambalam and Saidapet, NXTutors first looks for tutors who live in these streets, then tutors who already travel here, then others in Chennai, and online tutors at the end. Two or three reach you, matched to your child's class, board and subject, and every profile lists the tutor's own fee before you commit. The first lesson is a free demo, which is also a good time to agree how the tutor will come and where to park. If the tutor stops suiting your child later in the year, switching to another is free.
faqs: Which suburban stations serve this zone?

Nungambakkam, Kodambakkam, Mambalam and Saidapet, all on the South Line that opened in 1931. Mambalam is one of the city's busiest suburban stations and sits on T Nagar's western edge. Tutors coming by train usually finish with a short walk or auto, which avoids parking on the crowded bazaar streets.
Does Saidapet have metro access?

Yes. Two Blue Line stops, Saidapet and Little Mount, cover its western and southern sides, and the suburban railway has a Saidapet station too. Tutors living near either line can arrive by train and take a brief auto ride, though Saidapet's few newer gated complexes will want the visitor registered.
How many tutors will we get to compare for a West Mambalam request?

Two or three. They are chosen for your child's class, board and subject and ordered by distance, starting with tutors who live nearby. Each profile shows the fee the tutor charges before you book, the first lesson is a free demo, and if you later want someone else, the change is free.
Is Kodambakkam still a residential area?

Yes. Studios and businesses share it with residential streets, and flats keep rising where bungalows once stood. It also had one of the city's earliest flyovers, built in 1967. At a house the tutor goes straight to the door; a block of flats will usually want the name given at the entrance first.

intro: This long southern zone stretches from Guindy all the way down to Tambaram. Guindy's homes sit in residential pockets between an industrial estate, a national park and institutional campuses. Velachery mixes apartment complexes with independent houses, and Madipakkam, around its lake, is low-rise flats and houses on plotted streets. Nanganallur, near the airport and known for its temples, has flats by local builders, independent houses and builder floors. Pallikaranai, beside its protected marsh, ranges from apartment complexes and gated communities to villas and plots, Medavakkam adds apartments, houses and plotted layouts, and Chromepet and Tambaram mix older houses and layouts with newer apartment complexes.

Rail reaches much of the zone but not all of it. The Metro Blue Line runs through Little Mount, Guindy, Alandur, Nanganallur Road and Meenambakkam; the MRTS serves Velachery and, since March 2026, Puzhuthivakkam, Adambakkam and St Thomas Mount; and suburban trains run down GST Road through Pazhavanthangal and Chromepet to Tambaram, one of the city's main terminals. Medavakkam and Pallikaranai still wait for rail, with their Red Line stations still being built, so tutors there come by two-wheeler from Velachery or Madipakkam. The Kathipara interchange, the Vijayanagar junction in Velachery and GST Road carry the worst of the office traffic, so pick a weekly slot that misses it.

NXTutors searches this long zone nearest first: tutors who live in your part of it, from Guindy and Velachery to Chromepet and Tambaram, then tutors who already travel here, then the rest of Chennai, then online tutors. Two or three of them are matched to your child's class, board and subject and sent to you, each with a fee shown before any booking. The first lesson is a free demo, and you can switch to another tutor later without paying for the change. Tell us your locality and nearest station, because distances inside this zone vary a great deal.
faqs: How has the MRTS extension changed travel to Madipakkam?

Commercial service on the MRTS extension through Puzhuthivakkam and Adambakkam to St Thomas Mount began on 14 March 2026, so Puzhuthivakkam and Velachery are now the nearest rail points for Madipakkam. A tutor using rail still needs an auto or bus for the last leg; one from Velachery or Nanganallur can simply come by two-wheeler.
Can a tutor reach Chromepet or Tambaram by suburban train?

Yes. Chromepet station and Tambaram, one of the four main railway terminals in the Chennai area, are on the suburban line along GST Road, with frequent trains towards Guindy and Mambalam. A tutor can walk or take an auto from the station; gated complexes register visitors, while houses mean a doorstep visit.
What should a Velachery family expect to pay a home tutor?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. The figure for each tutor is on their profile before the free demo, and the tutor sets it.
How do tutors get to Pallikaranai and Medavakkam?

Mostly by two-wheeler, bus or cab from Velachery, Madipakkam or the OMR, since neither has a station yet; tutors who use the MRTS get off at Velachery and take an auto. Gated communities register visitors and some ask a resident to confirm, so share the tutor's details before the first visit.

intro: Two parallel roads define this zone: the OMR IT corridor and the East Coast Road by the sea. Perungudi's streets behind the office buildings hold apartments and houses for working families. Thoraipakkam, on the edge of the marsh, is mainly flats in multi-storey buildings and gated communities. Sholinganallur mixes large gated communities, budget flats and a housing-board township near the IT parks. Navalur, further south, is two- and three-bedroom apartments, villa communities and plots, and Kelambakkam, still a village panchayat, has plotted layouts, apartments and villas, many inside gated campuses. Neelankarai, on the ECR, is bungalows, villas, row houses and independent houses near the beach.

Apart from the MRTS stop at Perungudi, the corridor relies on its roads. The Purple Line through Thoraipakkam, Sholinganallur and Navallur and the Red Line towards Sholinganallur are both under construction, so most tutors come by two-wheeler, bus or cab from a nearby locality, and the Pallavaram–Thoraipakkam Radial Road brings some in from the GST Road side. Gated communities often want a resident to approve each visitor, and some ask for ID on the first visit. OMR traffic peaks when offices open and close, so lessons after the evening peak or at weekends are steadier, and the ECR is calmer on weekdays than at weekends.

NXTutors fills an OMR or ECR shortlist from the nearest outward: tutors living in Perungudi, Thoraipakkam, Sholinganallur, Navalur, Kelambakkam or Neelankarai, then tutors who already travel along the corridor, then the rest of Chennai, and online tutors, who are often the practical answer for an IB, IGCSE or advanced senior subject. You get two or three matches, see each tutor's fee before booking, and begin with a free demo. Switching tutor later is free. Adding your community name and gate details to the request saves time on the first visit.
faqs: Is there any metro on the OMR yet?

Not yet. The Purple Line is under construction along the OMR with stations including Perungudi, Thoraipakkam, Sholinganallur and Navallur, and the Red Line is being built to meet it at Sholinganallur. Today the only rail on this stretch is Perungudi's MRTS station, opened with the Velachery extension on 19 November 2007.
How do tutors reach Neelankarai on the ECR?

By road along the ECR from Thiruvanmiyur, Palavakkam or Injambakkam, or across from Thoraipakkam on the OMR, since there is no station. Most homes are bungalows, villas and independent houses, so the tutor comes to the door and parking is rarely a problem. Weekend beach traffic slows the ECR, so weekday lessons are simpler.
Can an OMR family keep one tutor at home and another online?

Yes. Tell us which subjects should be at home and which online, and we match tutors for each, nearest first for the home lessons. Every profile shows the tutor's fee before you book, the first class is a free demo, and you can change tutor later at no charge.
What should Sholinganallur families arrange before the first class?

Add the tutor as a regular visitor with your community's security, since the large gated communities here register every visitor and sometimes need a resident's approval. The Sholinganallur junction is heavy when offices open and close, so evening slots after the peak or weekend sessions suit tutors coming from Thoraipakkam, Medavakkam or Navalur.

intro: Much of this central-west belt was planned, so homes are easy to find. Anna Nagar, a planned township, has independent houses on plots and apartment buildings along numbered avenues laid out in a grid, and the same pattern continues into Anna Nagar West. Shenoy Nagar mixes older houses and low-rise apartments around a large public park. Kilpauk, once a cantonment, has independent houses and apartment buildings beside large institutional campuses. Aminjikarai is colonies of older houses and flats next to a busy market belt, Arumbakkam, a mango-growing area until around 1960, has colony homes and apartments, and Purasawalkam keeps old family houses and narrow lanes near its markets.

The underground Green Line gives tutors an easy way in. Thirumangalam, Anna Nagar Tower, Anna Nagar East and Shenoy Nagar opened in May 2017, and Arumbakkam, Koyambedu and CMBT have run since June 2015, so a tutor from Vadapalani or Ashok Nagar can ride straight in and walk a few streets. Kilpauk and Purasawalkam lie near the Green Line's eastern stations, and Chennai Central is close for tutors who come by suburban train. Poonamallee High Road, the Inner Ring Road and the Koyambedu junction carry heavy office traffic, and parking is tight near the 2nd Avenue shops and the Purasawalkam market streets, so earlier evening slots suit most homes.

Families in Anna Nagar, Anna Nagar West, Shenoy Nagar, Kilpauk, Aminjikarai, Arumbakkam and Purasawalkam get an NXTutors list built nearest first: tutors who live in this belt, then tutors who already travel into it, then the rest of Chennai, then online tutors. Two or three are matched to class, board and subject, and each profile shows the tutor's fee before you choose. The first lesson is a free demo on your child's current work, and changing tutor later is free. Your avenue, block or colony name helps us measure the real distance to your door.
faqs: Which Green Line stations serve Anna Nagar?

Three underground stations, Anna Nagar East, Anna Nagar Tower and Thirumangalam, all opened in May 2017. Thirumangalam is also the nearest working stop for Anna Nagar West, where a Red Line station is under construction. Because the avenue grid makes addresses easy to find, tutors arriving by metro reach most homes on foot or by a short auto.
Is Arumbakkam easy for a tutor to reach?

Yes. Arumbakkam station on the Green Line opened on 29 June 2015 as part of the first Koyambedu to Alandur section, with CMBT and Vadapalani next door on the same line. A tutor from Vadapalani, Anna Nagar or Ashok Nagar can arrive by metro and walk to the colony. Traffic at the Koyambedu junction builds at office hours.
What fees do tutors charge in Kilpauk and Shenoy Nagar?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own fee, which you see on the profile before the free demo.
Why is parking hard for tutors in Purasawalkam?

Its busy clothing, jewellery and food markets sit beside old family houses and narrow lanes, so street space is scarce. A tutor coming by metro or bus and walking the last part is usually quicker than one driving. Weekday evenings are busiest on Purasawalkam High Road, so a slightly earlier lesson slot helps.

intro: West of the film district, this zone runs along Arcot Road from dense Vadapalani to the IT stretch at Porur. Vadapalani, grown around a late nineteenth-century temple, has apartment buildings and older houses beside studios, shopping centres and a large bus terminus. KK Nagar's rectangular sectors, each with a park at its heart, and neighbouring Ashok Nagar, dating from 1964, both hold housing-board flats, newer apartments and independent houses on numbered roads. Virugambakkam is colonies of houses and apartment buildings, Valasaravakkam is mostly apartments popular with working professionals, and Porur mixes apartment buildings and older houses near the IT corridor on Mount-Poonamallee Road.

At the eastern end the metro is easy, because two Green Line stations, Vadapalani and Ashok Nagar, date from the line's first 2015 section, and the Inner Ring Road runs north to Koyambedu and south to Kathipara. Beyond Vadapalani, homes wait for the Yellow Line, still under construction along Arcot Road towards Porur, so for Virugambakkam, Valasaravakkam and Porur a tutor either takes a bus up Arcot Road or rides the Green Line to its Vadapalani stop and covers the rest by auto. Arcot Road and the meeting of three main roads at Porur Junction clog when offices close, so an earlier weekday slot or a weekend lesson keeps the routine steady.

NXTutors orders tutors for Vadapalani, Ashok Nagar, KK Nagar, Virugambakkam, Valasaravakkam and Porur by distance: those who live in the zone first, then tutors who already travel here, then other parts of Chennai, and online tutors for subjects that are hard to find locally. You receive two or three who fit your child's class, board and subject, with each fee visible before you book. The first class is a free demo, and if the tutor stops suiting your child, moving to another is free. Give your sector or road number so that we can judge the distance properly.
faqs: Is there a metro station near Virugambakkam or Valasaravakkam?

Not a working one. Both localities lie on the Yellow Line route out to Porur, where stations such as Virugambakkam South and Valasaravakkam are still under construction. For now, a tutor takes the Green Line as far as Vadapalani and then an auto, or uses the buses on Arcot Road, which slows badly at office hours.
Are KK Nagar and Ashok Nagar homes easy for a tutor to find?

Yes. KK Nagar's sectors and streets are numbered, and Ashok Nagar has a road-numbering system, so a first-time visitor finds the house quickly. Ashok Nagar's Green Line station is the nearest stop for both. In a block of flats, expect the watchman to note the visitor; at a house, the tutor simply rings the bell.
What if we want a different tutor after the demo?

You can have one. Your shortlist has two or three matched tutors, so pick another from it or ask us for a fresh match; switching tutor is free. Each profile shows the fee the tutor charges before you commit, so comparing options is straightforward, and tutors closest to you are still listed first.
Why is Porur Junction important for a tutor's timing?

Three main roads, Arcot Road, Mount-Poonamallee Road and Kundrathur Road, converge there, and the Chennai Bypass crosses nearby, so traffic backs up whenever offices open or close. With Porur's metro stations still under construction, every tutor comes by road, so schedule lessons outside those hours or move rarer subjects online.

intro: The western belt combines settled colonies with large planned estates. Mogappair, divided into an eastern and a western half, began as a village, a sliver of which still survives, and today its streets hold flats alongside older homes on plots, with the Padi and Ambattur industrial estates beyond. Ambattur's residential colonies, laid out around a large industrial estate commissioned in 1964, combine family houses, flats and older layouts, with Korattur, Padi and Thiruverkadu among its neighbours. Avadi, a municipal corporation since 2019 and home to major defence establishments, has housing-board estates, family houses, plotted layouts and apartment projects, with Pattabiram and Thirumullaivoyal close by.

For Ambattur and Avadi, rail is the natural choice: local trains on the Arakkonam line call at Pattaravakkam, Ambattur, Thirumullaivoyal, Annanur and Avadi, where many services terminate. A tutor based anywhere along that line, from Villivakkam or Perambur outward, can ride in and walk or take an auto from the platform. Mogappair is off the railway, so tutors come by bus, by Green Line to Thirumangalam or Koyambedu, or via Korattur station. The Tiruvallur highway through Ambattur and the Inner Ring Road near Mogappair fill up when offices open and close, so choose a late-afternoon or weekend slot for regular lessons.

Tutor lists for Mogappair, Ambattur and Avadi on NXTutors begin with tutors who live in these localities, then add tutors who already travel west to teach, then the wider city, and online tutors last, useful above all for specialist subjects. You receive two or three who fit your child's class, board and subject, each with the fee on the profile before you book. The first lesson is a free demo. If you later feel another tutor would suit better, the switch is free, and the new list is built nearest first in the same way.
faqs: Which railway stations are nearest to Ambattur homes?

Ambattur and Pattaravakkam stations, with Thirumullaivoyal the next halt towards Avadi, all on the Arakkonam suburban line, whose first electrified stretch opened on 29 November 1979. Tutors living on the line can arrive by local train and walk or ride an auto to the colony; newer blocks may want the visitor's name at the gate.
What should Avadi families send a tutor before the demo?

Share the complete address, a phone number to call on arrival and which gate to use. Homes near defence establishments and in gated estates can require entry to be arranged beforehand, whereas plotted layouts and housing-board streets are easier. Tutors often come by local train to Avadi's terminal station and ride an auto from there.
How much do home tutors cost in Mogappair?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors set their own rates and list them, so you compare your matches before the free demo.
How does a tutor reach Mogappair?

Buses are the mainstay, with several terminals serving both halves of the locality, and the Green Line to Thirumangalam or Koyambedu plus an auto is the metro option. Korattur, Pattaravakkam and Ambattur stations help tutors on the suburban railway. At a family house the tutor rings the bell; flats sometimes keep a visitor book.

intro: North Chennai is dense, old and closely tied to the railway. Perambur, where railway workshops were set up in 1856, has a busy market, older independent houses and newer apartment buildings. Villivakkam is packed with houses and apartment buildings on both sides of the tracks, joined by a road subway. Kolathur, a long-established housing colony famous for its ornamental fish trade, is independent houses and low- to mid-rise flats around busy local markets. Royapuram, beside the sea and its fishing harbour, runs from old family houses in narrow lanes to newer flats, and Tondiarpet mixes trading houses and small factories with older homes and apartment buildings.

Few parts of Chennai have more rail for their size. Perambur has three suburban stations on the line towards Avadi and Arakkonam, and Villivakkam is on the same line; Royapuram, whose 1856 station was the earliest terminus in the south, still has suburban trains; and Tondiarpet has both a suburban station on the Gummidipoondi line and a Blue Line metro stop, opened in February 2021. Kolathur relies on Villivakkam station and buses until its Red Line station, now under construction, opens. Narrow lanes and market streets leave little parking, so tutors who come by train, metro or auto and arrive a little before the evening crowd tend to keep time.

NXTutors lists tutors for Perambur, Villivakkam, Kolathur, Royapuram and Tondiarpet nearest first: those who live in north Chennai, then those who already travel here, then the rest of the city, then online tutors. faqs: Which is the oldest railway station in the zone?

Royapuram, which opened in June 1856 as the first railway terminus in South India and has the oldest surviving station buildings in the country's rail network. It still has suburban trains. Perambur, the second oldest station in the city, is nearby, so tutors in north Chennai have several rail options to choose from.
Is there a metro near Kolathur?

Not yet. Red Line stations at Kolathur Junction and Villivakkam are under construction in Chennai Metro Phase II. For now tutors usually come by bus or by suburban train to Villivakkam and finish with an auto. Red Hills Road is busiest at office hours, so evening lessons do better with a slightly later start.
Do we see the fee before the demo lesson?

Yes. Each tutor we send lists their own fee on the profile before you book the free demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
How do tutors reach Tondiarpet?

By metro or suburban train. Tondiarpet station on the Blue Line opened on 14 February 2021 with the northern extension to Wimco Nagar, and Tondiarpet railway station is on the line towards Gummidipoondi. Commercial roads are busiest during the working day, so evening or weekend lessons are usually smoother for a visiting tutor.
